verdict.rationale: Aleph documents headcount planning backed by live HRIS, ATS, ERP, and spreadsheet data, and offers HRIS/ERP connectors and versioned forecasts. That is a first-party capability that plausibly ties plans to payroll actuals. The evidence never shows role-level planning granularity or planned hires automatically flowing into the expense forecast. missing for 10: explicit role/position-level headcount modeling, documented linkage of planned hires to the expense forecast, explicit payroll-actuals reconciliation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
